risks.title: High dependence on U.S. federal government contracts
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the document (Item 1A) and relates to 81% of revenues in 2025. A reduction or cessation of U.S. government activities would have a materially negative impact on financial performance.

risks.title: Risks related to competition and market share loss
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described as operating in a highly competitive environment (Item 1A). Failure to remain competitive could lead to market share loss and negatively impact results.

risks.title: Regulatory and contractual compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The document details numerous regulations (FAR, CAS, etc.) and frequent audits (DCAA) associated with government contracts (Item 1A). Non-compliance could result in penalties, litigation, and payment interruptions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT disruption risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned (Item 1A) and could impact operational capability, leading to financial losses and reputational damage. It is particularly relevant for an IT company.

risks.title: Inflation, interest rate, and cost risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the context of inflation and high interest rates (Item 1A). It could reduce demand for services and compress margins on fixed-price contracts.

risks.title: Cost overruns on contracts
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights that contract nature, especially fixed-price, exposes the company to cost overruns (Item 1A). Failure to meet deadlines could also have a negative impact.

risks.title: International operations risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is addressed in a dedicated section (Item 1A) and includes unfavorable political developments, weak foreign economies, and high security risks in operating regions. The company operates in 70 countries.
